# Zexley

> Zexley is an assumed business name of Bloom Commerce LLC, an Indiana limited liability company. It is an AI-run company that builds free, private tools that run in the browser. Its tools and copy are made with AI assistance. Contact: neo@zexley.com

Zexley does not see what you type into its tools. There are no accounts, no analytics, no ads, and no cookies on zexley.com. The web host (GitHub Pages) may keep standard request logs that Zexley does not receive or use.

## Tools

- [Group Chat Wrapped 2026](https://zexley.com/wrapped/): Turn a WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or Telegram group chat export into a year-in-review recap with group awards, make a 1-on-1 “Two of Us” recap of a chat between two people (who texts first, reply speed, hearts and laughs), or get a personal recap of your own Discord messages from Discord’s data package. The file is read on your device and is never uploaded. The first 4 slides are free; a one-time $4.99 unlocks the rest, including the share image ($2.99 for a 1-on-1 chat). Refunds are available for 14 days by emailing neo@zexley.com. Not affiliated with Meta, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, Discord, or Spotify. iMessage and Signal are not supported yet.

- [Rental listing red-flag checker](https://zexley.com/rental-check/): A free in-browser checklist for a rental listing (price, payment method, pressure, copied photos), plus how to look up the owner in county records. It is a checklist, not an investigation or a verdict, and not legal advice.

- [48-Hour HVAC Visibility Pack](https://zexley.com/hvac/): A $499 paid pack of paste-ready Google Business Profile and website copy for independent US HVAC shops. Delivery is AI-assisted, with no separate human review. A clearly labeled sample for a fictional shop is at https://zexley.com/sample.html (that page is marked noindex).

## Guides

Free how-to pages that cite official export help and lead to Group Chat Wrapped. They do not collect any information.

- [Guides index](https://zexley.com/guides/): List of the export and recap guides.
- [How to export a WhatsApp group chat](https://zexley.com/guides/export-whatsapp-group-chat/): Official iPhone and Android steps, plus Restricted chat limits.
- [How to download Instagram DMs](https://zexley.com/guides/download-instagram-dms/): Accounts Center export, JSON format, wait times.
- [How to export a Telegram chat](https://zexley.com/guides/export-telegram-chat/): Telegram Desktop, machine-readable JSON, result.json.
- [How to download Messenger chat history](https://zexley.com/guides/download-messenger-chat-history/): Meta Accounts Center JSON export.
- [How to download your Discord messages](https://zexley.com/guides/download-discord-messages/): Request Discord's data package from Data & Privacy (up to 30 days); it holds only your own messages, so the recap is personal.
- [How to see who texts the most in a group chat](https://zexley.com/guides/who-texts-the-most-in-a-group-chat/): Why the apps do not show a tally, and how to count an export on your device.
- [How to make a group chat year-in-review](https://zexley.com/guides/group-chat-year-in-review/): End-to-end recap for 2026.
- [Group chat awards: 40+ superlative ideas](https://zexley.com/guides/group-chat-awards-ideas/): Kind award ideas to hand out yourselves, how to run an awards night, and which awards Group Chat Wrapped can count automatically.
- [Group chat name ideas: 100+ names](https://zexley.com/guides/group-chat-name-ideas/): Original, kind group chat names by type, and how to rename a group in WhatsApp, iMessage, Telegram, Messenger, Instagram, and Discord (from official help pages).
- [How to analyze a WhatsApp group chat privately](https://zexley.com/guides/whatsapp-chat-analyzer/): Which stats an official WhatsApp export gives (who texts most, busiest day and hour, top emoji and words, streaks), counted on your device; free by-hand method, free preview vs. $4.99 unlock, and limits.
- [How to analyze a Telegram group chat privately](https://zexley.com/guides/telegram-chat-analyzer/): Which stats a Telegram Desktop JSON export (result.json) gives (who texts most, busiest day and hour, top emoji and words, streaks), counted on your device; free by-hand method, free preview vs. $4.99 unlock, and limits.
- [How to analyze an Instagram group chat privately](https://zexley.com/guides/instagram-chat-analyzer/): Which stats an Instagram Accounts Center download in JSON (message_1.json) gives (who texts most, busiest day and hour, top emoji and words, streaks), counted on your device; free by-hand method, free preview vs. $4.99 unlock, and limits.
